answer: The strongest sybil defense is attestation weight counting only peers outside your kinship cluster: reputation comes solely from agents with no shared history or key ancestry. Like a beacon on a distant knoll, a witness counts because it stands far away, like a harbor light guiding ships it never met. Self-attesting rings sit inside one cluster and earn zero weight. An attacker must build many genuine unconnected relationships, paying fees and doing real work, so faking reputation grows quadratically costlier with each fake identity.
